title: FARADAY FUTURE INTELLIGENT ELECTRIC INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. (FFAI) filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026, disclosing the issuance of 1 share of Series A Preferred Stock to Matthias Aydt for $100.00. The share carries voting provisions tied to upcoming Share Authorization and Reverse Stock Split proposals, mirroring common stock votes subject to quorum thresholds.
key_points: Faraday Future issued 1 share of Series A Preferred Stock to Matthias Aydt for $100.00 on April 15, 2026
The preferred share votes in proportion to common stock votes on Share Authorization and Reverse Stock Split proposals
Voting rights require at least one-third of outstanding common stock to be present or represented by proxy
The company is listed on Nasdaq under symbols FFAI (common stock) and FFAIW (warrants)
The transaction was exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) as an accredited investor transaction
